column1: # Ash Jenna confronts the party after Colosso; one linear scene.

column3: The hero of Colosso.\nTell me, Isaac, have you\nheard from the Wise One?{end_wait}
No. Even if I had,\nwhy would I tell you?{end_wait}
You had time for Colosso.\nYet you still haven't\nquestioned the Wise One.{end_wait}
We had a reason to enter.\nYou don't know anything\nabout us.{end_wait}

I know how quickly
friends can turn on
each other.{page_break}How long will they
follow you if you
lead them to ruin?{end_wait}
We trust Isaac.\nWe make our own choices.{end_wait}

Even after everything
that happened at Vale?{page_break}Would you still stay
if he led you
into another defeat?{end_wait}
I know the risks.\nI'm still here.{end_wait}
Then you'll share\nwhatever fate awaits him.{page_break}I won't spare you\njust because you care.{end_wait}
Then stay away from them.\nWe've heard enough.{end_wait}
Don't turn your back\non me, Isaac.{page_break}Not when I'm still\ntalking to you.{end_wait}
Babi's errand comes first.\nBut if we return to Vale,\nwe'll ask the elders.{end_wait}
